openQuestions: Only the five smoke cases were executed on request. The other 23 cases are written and reviewed but have no spec yet, so they are Pending. Should the next run implement all of them?

Six of the pending cases (TC-CHK-005, TC-CHK-007, TC-PROD-003, TC-PROD-005, TC-PROD-006, TC-CART-006) are written to the correct expected behaviour and are expected to fail against the current site. They will produce bug drafts when they run.

The run used the Google Chrome already installed on the machine (channel: chrome) instead of downloading Playwright's own chromium build. Is that acceptable as the standard browser for this flow, or should the bundled chromium be installed?
The demo site keeps no order history, so the QA-AUTO- order placed by TC-CHK-001 leaves nothing behind. On a real environment this case will need a cleanup step.
